real_defects.issue: wildmatch compared JS characters, git compares bytes: `?`, `[...]` and ranges took a whole non-ASCII character, so `caf?.txt` was reported to ignore café.txt and `n[!a]o` to ignore néo, while `git check-ignore` ignores neither (reproduced with git 2.43). Fixed by matching non-ASCII pattern/text as UTF-8 byte strings; failing-first test plus a 150-repo UTF-8 differential test against git.
